description: Behaviour of ./sandbox.sh stop. The Bash `cmd_stop` was captured byte for byte before it was removed; these values are the contract for asf.stop. {PREFIX} is the checkout resource prefix, {SANDBOX} the physical checkout path, and {T} an elapsed-second count the test normalises.
notes: 14 of 17 vectors are byte-identical to Bash. The rest carry a `divergence` note and keep the Bash bytes as bash_*.
Elapsed seconds are tokenised: `_cleanup_action` prints wall-clock time, so a byte-exact comparison would be a race against the clock.
The engine is a scripted fake (tests/parity/fake_podman_stop.py) that mutates, so `remaining` proves what each implementation actually left.
Every divergence makes Python stricter: it removes something Bash left, or it reports a failure Bash reported as success. None goes the other way.

manifests.proxy-agent:
name: proxy-agent
llm:
  broker: true
  protocol: anthropic
  provider: anthropic
  api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  direct_domain: api.anthropic.com
network:
  mode: proxy
  allow_domains: [statsig.com]
  verify_domain: statsig.com
manifests.routed-agent:
name: routed-agent
capabilities: [net_raw]
network:
  mode: routed
  allow:
    - cidr: 192.0.2.10/32
      protocol: tcp
      ports: [18080]
  verify:
    address: 192.0.2.10
    protocol: tcp
    port: 18080
    blocked_port: 19999
